summary: The package module is a generic front end that calls the OS's package manager module (detected via setup), supporting only the common arguments. Package names aren't translated between distros; Windows uses win_package.
questions: How do I install packages across Debian and RHEL with one task?
Does the package module translate package names between distros?
Which package manager does ansible.builtin.package use?
How do I install packages on Windows?

answer_card.title: Generic package management
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.package` proxies to the detected package manager (via `setup` facts) so one task works across distros. Only common arguments are guaranteed. It does **not** translate names (e.g. `libyaml-dev` vs `libyaml-devel`), so use variables. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_package`.
